The refactor preserves the existing fail-closed guard and focused-test coverage.

falsifier_or_remaining_gap: A pinned structured gate runner with explicit per-stage deadlines, deterministic stage receipts, and focused timeout and failure-attribution tests would falsify the finding. This audit measured source structure and dispatch wiring but did not execute the complete push gate.
impact: A large single-line shell pipeline is difficult to review or diff, identifies failures only through nested command output, and provides no bounded completion contract for an individual stalled stage.
lead_verification_obligations: Approve the stage vocabulary, timeout policy, receipt format, and compatibility boundary before implementation.
Run one forthcoming single stable complete open-pull-request census before assigning an implementation owner or recording overlaps.
Verify the refactor preserves every existing branch-gate command and fails closed on timeout, missing commands, empty scope, and malformed stage configuration.
